name: Factory reset
description: Erases all Nuxiva data, fingerprints and credentials and returns the system to its initial setup, as if freshly installed, with multiple confirmations and a final proof that everything was deleted.
capabilities: Inventory of everything that will be erased before you proceed
Administrator password re-entry and a random confirmation phrase
Mandatory wait and an expiring one-time code, against accidental clicks
Final verification: no leftovers, sample files gone, no process still holding data open
Session keys and secrets regenerated, first-run setup wizard reopened
